entity-type.label: Logic Layer
entity-type.description: One of 72 operational logic layers governing Company Brain behavior.

entity-type.label: Logic Domain
entity-type.description: One of 12 master domains organizing logic layers.

entity-type.label: Control Plane
entity-type.description: Decision authority and oversight point for specific logics (CP-001 to CP-072).

entity-type.label: Agent
entity-type.description: Autonomous or interactive entity that executes decisions, workflows, or capabilities.

entity-type.label: Capability
entity-type.description: Specific ability, skill, or capacity the organization can execute.

entity-type.label: Workflow
entity-type.description: Sequence of steps and decision points executed by agents.

entity-type.label: Venture
entity-type.description: Business operated or owned by the organization.

entity-type.label: Repository
entity-type.description: Code repository implementing capabilities or powering ventures.

entity-type.label: Tool
entity-type.description: Software tool, service, or API used by agents or workflows.

entity-type.label: Policy
entity-type.description: Rule governing behavior, permissions, or constraints.

entity-type.label: Decision
entity-type.description: Choice point or determination made by an agent or control plane.

entity-type.label: Event
entity-type.description: Occurrence that triggers logic execution or state changes.

entity-type.label: State
entity-type.description: Current condition or status of an entity.

entity-type.label: Metric
entity-type.description: Measured value used to evaluate logic execution quality.

entity-type.label: Model
entity-type.description: AI model (Claude, GPT, Ollama, etc.) used for reasoning or generation.

entity-type.label: Prompt
entity-type.description: Instructions given to a model to guide behavior.

entity-type.label: Knowledge
entity-type.description: Information, facts, or understanding retrieved or maintained by the system.

entity-type.label: Evaluation
entity-type.description: Assessment of logic execution, agent performance, or system health.

relationship.label: belongs-to-domain
relationship.description: A logic layer is part of a master domain.

relationship.label: governed-by-control-plane
relationship.description: A logic layer is overseen by a specific control plane.

relationship.label: executes-logic
relationship.description: An agent implements or executes a specific logic.

relationship.label: governed-by-agent
relationship.description: A logic layer is executed by a responsible agent.

relationship.label: capable-of
relationship.description: An agent can execute a specific capability.

relationship.label: executes-workflow
relationship.description: An agent runs or orchestrates a workflow.

relationship.label: uses-tool
relationship.description: An agent uses a tool to execute actions.

relationship.label: uses-model
relationship.description: An agent uses an AI model for reasoning or generation.

relationship.label: uses-prompt
relationship.description: An agent follows specific prompting instructions.

relationship.label: reads-knowledge
relationship.description: An agent retrieves or reads knowledge to inform decisions.

relationship.label: writes-knowledge
relationship.description: An agent creates or updates knowledge.

relationship.label: delegates-to-agent
relationship.description: An agent delegates work to another agent.

relationship.label: escalates-to-agent
relationship.description: An agent escalates decisions to a higher-level agent.

relationship.label: collaborates-with-agent
relationship.description: Agents work together on shared goals.

relationship.label: triggered-by-event
relationship.description: A workflow starts when an event occurs.

relationship.label: has-step
relationship.description: A workflow contains sequential steps or sub-workflows.

relationship.label: produces-output
relationship.description: A workflow generates results or knowledge.

relationship.label: implemented-by-repository
relationship.description: A capability is implemented in code within a repository.

relationship.label: requires-capability
relationship.description: One capability depends on another.

relationship.label: enables-venture
relationship.description: A capability is needed for a venture to operate.

relationship.label: powers-venture
relationship.description: Code in a repository powers or enables a venture.

relationship.label: depends-on-repository
relationship.description: One repository depends on another (dependency).

relationship.label: tested-by-evaluation
relationship.description: A repository is tested and validated by an evaluation.

relationship.label: constrained-by-policy
relationship.description: A logic layer is constrained or governed by a policy.

relationship.label: requires-approval
relationship.description: A logic layer decision requires oversight/approval from a control plane.

relationship.label: applies-to-venture
relationship.description: A policy applies to operations of a venture.

relationship.label: has-state
relationship.description: An entity currently has a specific state.

relationship.label: triggered-by
relationship.description: A logic layer is triggered or activated by an event.

relationship.label: produces-event
relationship.description: Agent execution produces an observable event.

relationship.label: evaluated-by
relationship.description: A logic layer is assessed by an evaluation.

relationship.label: measures
relationship.description: A metric quantifies execution of a logic layer.

relationship.label: validated-by
relationship.description: An agent's decisions are validated by evaluation.

relationship.label: documents
relationship.description: Knowledge documents or explains a logic layer.

relationship.label: references
relationship.description: Knowledge references or cites an entity.

relationship.label: derived-from
relationship.description: Knowledge is derived from evaluation results.

relationship.label: supports-decision
relationship.description: Knowledge supports a decision made by an agent.

relationship.label: made-by-agent
relationship.description: A decision is made by a specific agent.

relationship.label: based-on-logic
relationship.description: A decision is made based on a logic layer's rules.

relationship.label: results-in-action
relationship.description: A decision results in a workflow execution.

domain.name: DECISION & POLICY
domain.description: Decisions, policies, permissions, approvals, risk, compliance (Logics 15-20)

domain.name: INTELLIGENCE
domain.description: Agents, models, prompts, context, memory, retrieval, tools, orchestration (Logics 31-40)

domain.name: STATE & EVENT
domain.description: Events, state, temporal logic, dependencies, graph (Logics 41-45)

domain.name: DATA & VALIDATION
domain.description: Data logic, validation, verification, evaluation, quality (Logics 46-50)

logic-layer.name: Objective Logic
logic-layer.question: What are we trying to accomplish?

logic-layer.name: Economic Logic
logic-layer.question: Does the action make financial sense?

logic-layer.name: Revenue Logic
logic-layer.question: How do we turn activity into revenue?

logic-layer.name: Customer Logic
logic-layer.question: Who do we serve and how?

control-plane.name: CP-001: Identity Control Plane
control-plane.description: Strategic decision authority over organizational identity and definition.

control-plane.name: CP-002: Objectives Control Plane
control-plane.description: Sets and oversees organizational objectives and goal hierarchy.

control-plane.name: CP-003: Strategy Control Plane
control-plane.description: Approves and monitors strategic decisions and plans.

control-plane.name: CP-004: Business Rules Control Plane
control-plane.description: Maintains and enforces core business rule definitions.

agent.name: Strategic Identity Agent
agent.description: Maintains organizational identity and definition. Executes Logic-001.

agent.name: Goal-Setting Agent
agent.description: Sets organizational objectives and ensures alignment. Executes Logic-002.

agent.name: Strategy Agent
agent.description: Develops and evaluates strategic approaches. Executes Logic-003.

agent.name: Business Rules Engine
agent.description: Evaluates decisions against core business rules. Executes Logic-004.

model.name: Claude Opus 5
model.description: Flagship reasoning model for complex strategic decisions.

model.name: Claude Sonnet 5
model.description: Balanced model for tactical execution and analysis.

model.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
model.description: Fast, lightweight model for routine operations.

model.name: Ollama Local (Qwen, Llama, Hermes)
model.description: Local models for air-gapped or cost-sensitive operations.

prompt.name: Identity Definition Prompt
prompt.description: Guides Strategic Identity Agent in defining organizational identity.
